claim: Patchline ships a standards-track RFC for the gate-certificate format with at least two interoperable implementations. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the interoperable claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make certificate-rfc-standards-track-gate`.
